caption: The video captures a woman with a long dark ponytail standing in a dance studio, her back angled toward a large mirrored wall that reflects her front-facing image. She wears a black sleeveless top, a short black pleated skirt with a studded chain belt, and black knee-high boots. White walls, a pale wood floor, and a track-lit dark ceiling frame the room. At the start her hands are raised near her face, then draw together in front of her neck. As the clip continues, her arms cross over her torso while she lifts the leg nearer the mirror off the floor. This lifted-leg posture is held before the leg returns to the ground. Her stance then widens while her arms remain crossed near her chest. In the later frames, the mirror-side arm extends outward with an open hand while the other stays near her neck. Her legs spread further and her hips shift slightly as the movement develops. Throughout, the mirror reproduces each pose as a synchronized front-facing reflection.
relations: Starting with hands near face, the woman draws them together at her neck then crosses them over her torso.
While arms remain crossed, she lifts the mirror-side leg off the floor, holds it, then returns it down.
After the leg returns, her stance widens and hips shift as the mirror-side arm extends outward with an open hand.
The mirrored wall reproduces each pose as a synchronized front-facing reflection throughout the movement.
